preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.
The _maxTxAmount state variable must be greater than 0 to allow normal transfers.

exploit_hint: The attacker, acting as the contract owner, should call the `setMaxTxPercent` function with the `maxTxAmount` parameter set to 0. This action updates the `_maxTxAmount` state variable to zero. Consequently, any subsequent transfer attempts by non-owner accounts will fail due to the `require(amount <= _maxTxAmount)` check in the `_transfer` function, effectively halting all non-owner token transfers.
